crossRefs.note: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men…
You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if…

translations.web: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
translations.bsb: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
translations.kjv: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
translations.asv: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
